Gunman opens fire in Polish city of Krakow, killing 6 people and injuring 15
What we know so far after Polish gunman opens fire in Krakow main square

headline: Six People Killed In Shooting Incident At Krakow Main Square
seoTitle: Gunman Opens Fire In Krakow Main Square
metaDescription: Six people have died and at least fifteen are injured following a random shooting by a gunman in military clothing at a market square in Krakow, Poland.
aiSummaryBullets: A gunman wearing military clothing drove into Krakow's main market square and fired randomly at bystanders.
The incident resulted in the deaths of six people and left fifteen to sixteen individuals injured.
Police confronted the shooter, who was wounded during an exchange of gunfire and subsequently taken into custody.
aiContextParagraph: On November 7, 2026, a violent incident occurred in the city of Krakow, Poland, when an armed individual initiated a random shooting in the city's main market square. According to reports, the assailant arrived in the area by vehicle while wearing military-style fatigues and began firing indiscriminately at pedestrians around 3:00 p.m. local time. The event led to the fatalities of six individuals, while at least fifteen to sixteen others sustained injuries. Law enforcement authorities engaged the suspect in a gunfight, ultimately wounding the individual and taking them into official custody. Poland’s interior minister has publicly noted that preliminary investigations suggest the perpetrator may have held interests aligned with far-right ideologies. The square, a prominent tourist location, was secured by police forces immediately following the intervention. Investigations into the shooter's background and specific motives remain ongoing as local officials process the scene.
whyItIsViral: The event has reached a significant viral velocity due to high-profile reporting across multiple major international news outlets regarding a mass casualty incident in a prominent tourist location.
